versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion is machine-checked by extraction/verify_all.py (must equal tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json version). pageSpecVersion is enforced by the schema (const). repositoryVersion is documentation-only and hand-maintained; nothing checks it.
sourceStack: Documentation only, never used by contracts: the reference build is a single-page app (React 18 + Vite 5, Tailwind v3 with preflight off but almost all styling in plain CSS: src/index.css, src/case.css) with a three.js r169 WebGL canvas (src/engine/cosmos.js + shaders.js) rendering the portrait cosmos. Routes: '/' and /work/<slug>.
sourceNotice: The reference build reconstructs https://vadimcarazan.com, the real, live portfolio of a named designer. The clone uses placeholder content (procedural work art, placeholder name 'Morgan Ellsworth' / studio 'Fernway', its own mark and signature, Instrument Serif in place of the commercial PP Editorial Old Italic, a user-supplied portrait). Much of its UI copy is verbatim from the original. Never reproduce the original's work images, portrait, signature, lettering, logo or copy. See docs/sensitivity-and-licensing.md. Do not publish this repository.

designPolicy.contentHashMethod: extraction/policy_hash.py: for each contentHashFiles entry in order append '<path>\n<sha256 hex of bytes>\n'; contentHash = 'sha256:' + sha256 hex of that text. Recomputed and compared by extraction/verify_all.py (design-policy check).

cloneClassification.rationale: The reference build is a design-language reconstruction of vadimcarazan.com, not a faithful reference clone. Substituted by design: the work images (procedural placeholders, never the original's), the portrait (user-supplied, not the original photo), the name lettering and the mark (generated), the signature (own path), the copy inside the WebGL field (placeholder name, studio and project titles) and the commercial serif (Instrument Serif in its place). Its 15 generated case-study routes (/work/<slug>) have no live counterpart: the original is a single route and returns HTTP 404 for each of them, its case studies being external links.
substituted: copy inside the WebGL field and placeholder identity
